buyerGuidePage.ctaSubtitleTurkey: Our Türkiye experts will guide you through the Turkish real estate market

step1.title: Why Türkiye?
step1.description: Investing in real estate in Turkey gives you access to a market that moves because of real demand, not hype. The country's location, tourism, and young population keep the housing market active all year.
step1.fullDescription: You can find everything from simple city apartments to family projects and coastal homes in places like Istanbul, Antalya, and Bodrum. Foreign buyers also have a clear path to ownership, and some properties offer residency or even citizenship. It's a market with real opportunity, but you still need to understand the basics, because not every area works the same. With proper guidance, Turkey can offer solid long-term value.

step2.title: Prepare and Verify
step2.description: After you pick a property, the first step is making sure all the paperwork is clean. This means checking the title deed, the construction license, and confirming there are no debts on the unit.
step2.fullDescription: Most buyers sign a small reservation or a simple sales agreement and leave a deposit while these checks are done. Having someone experienced look at the documents is important, because missing one small detail can delay the whole purchase. When everything is clear, you can move forward without worry.

step3.title: Complete the Transfer
step3.description: Once the legal checks are finished, the official steps begin. You get a tax number, arrange your payments, and complete the valuation report if needed.
step3.fullDescription: When all documents are ready, you and the seller meet at the Land Registry Office to transfer the title. After the fees and remaining balance are paid, the TAPU is issued in your name. From that moment, the property is officially yours. You can then open the utilities, register the home, and start using it or renting it out right away.

step4.title: Voi Home Has Your Back
step4.description: At Voi Home, we make sure the entire process stays simple and organized. We help you choose the right project, check every document, follow up with developers, and handle the transfer at the Land Registry until you receive your TAPU.
step4.fullDescription: We only work with trusted developers and follow every rule so you don't deal with stress or surprises. With our team beside you, you can buy property in Turkey knowing your time, your money, and your peace of mind are protected.

story.title: The Story Behind Voi Home
story.tagline:
Some people sell a property.
Voi Home studies the life around it.
story.paragraph1: Behind every sound investment is a hundred small decisions most buyers never see: the direction a building faces, how a management company answers the phone, the gap between a listing photo and the apartment itself. Voi Home was built to catch every one of them.
story.paragraph2: We don't believe our clients should have to take a developer's word for it, or navigate title deeds, permits, and inspection reports alone. We do that work first, so the only decision left for you is whether the home is right for your life.
story.paragraph3: Rooted in Istanbul and Bodrum, Voi Home works exclusively across Türkiye, so every recommendation comes from firsthand knowledge of the street, the building, and the neighborhood, not a spreadsheet.
story.closingLine1: Because a property is never just a property.

mission.title: What We Stand For
mission.tagline: To look past the listing and into the life it holds.
mission.description: Voi Home exists to remove guesswork from buying property in Türkiye. We inspect what others overlook, ask the questions others skip, and turn every detail, large or small, into something our clients can rely on.

vision.title: Our Long-Term Vision
vision.tagline: To be the most trusted name in Turkish real estate, one detail at a time.
vision.description: A brand our clients return to long after the keys change hands, not because we sold them a property, but because we understood what they were actually looking for. Voi Home is committed to Türkiye, and to doing right by everyone who trusts us here.

founder.title: About the Founder
founder.description: Samer Al Helwani is a real estate professional with over 15 years of experience, having facilitated property transactions with a collective value exceeding $40 million USD. Trusted by investors, homeowners, and international buyers, he has built his reputation on market expertise, transparency, and a client-first approach. His vision for Voi Home is to make investing in Türkiye simple, secure, and rewarding, by paying attention to the details that matter and providing honest guidance at every stage of the journey.

item1.title: Knowledge Leads
item1.description: Every recommendation is backed by research, market insight, and experience. We don't follow trends, we understand them before they become obvious.

item2.title: Trust Above Everything
item2.description: Trust isn't earned through promises. It's built through honesty, transparency, and consistently putting our clients' interests first.

item3.title: Opportunities, Not Listings
item3.description: Anyone can show a property. We identify opportunities that align with our clients' financial goals, lifestyle, and long-term vision.

item4.title: Every Client Has a Strategy
item4.description: No two investors are alike. Every recommendation is tailored to the person behind the investment, ensuring every decision has purpose.

item5.title: Built for the Long Term
item5.description: Our relationship doesn't end when the contract is signed. We aim to become the trusted advisor our clients return to for every step of their real estate journey.
